title: A Day as a Volunteer
genre: ชีวิตนักเรียน
text:
Last Saturday, my class volunteered at a home for elderly people. We cleaned the rooms, planted flowers and (1) lunch for everyone. Some of us sang songs, (2) others played board games with the residents. One old man, Uncle Chai, told me about his life. He had been a teacher, a farmer and a taxi (3).
He spoke slowly but (4), and his stories were funny and (5). He said that the secret to a happy life is not having money but (6) good friends. Before we left, the residents thanked us not only with words but also (7) small gifts they had made.
I learned that helping others is as important as (8) well at school. Next month, we will go back to visit them and (9) them our photos. I am looking forward to seeing Uncle Chai and (10) more of his stories.

items.stem: (1) We cleaned the rooms, planted flowers and ___ lunch for everyone.
why_wrong: cooking ไม่ขนาน
to cook ไม่ขนาน
cook ไม่ขนาน (เป็นปัจจุบัน)

items.stem: (2) Some of us sang songs, ___ others played board games with the residents.
items.explanation_th: บางคน… ขณะที่คนอื่น… → while
why_wrong: so ไม่สมเหตุผล
because ไม่สมเหตุผล
unless ไม่สมเหตุผล

items.stem: (3) He had been a teacher, a farmer and a taxi ___.
items.explanation_th: a teacher, a farmer ↔ a taxi driver (คำนามบอกอาชีพ)
why_wrong: driving ไม่ใช่อาชีพ
drive เป็นกริยา
drove เป็นกริยา

items.stem: (4) He spoke slowly but ___, and his stories were funny and ….
why_wrong: clear เป็น adjective
clarity เป็นคำนาม
more clear เป็น adjective

items.stem: (5) He spoke slowly but …, and his stories were funny and ___.
items.explanation_th: funny ↔ interesting (adjective ที่บรรยายเรื่อง)
why_wrong: interest เป็นคำนาม
interestingly เป็น adverb
interested ใช้กับคนที่รู้สึก

items.stem: (6) He said that the secret to a happy life is not having money but ___ good friends.
items.explanation_th: not having money but having good friends
why_wrong: to have ไม่ขนาน
have ไม่ขนาน
had ไม่ขนาน

items.stem: (7) Before we left, the residents thanked us not only with words but also ___ small gifts they had made.
items.explanation_th: not only with words but also with gifts
why_wrong: by ไม่ขนานกับ with
for ไม่ขนาน
of ไม่ขนาน

items.stem: (8) I learned that helping others is as important as ___ well at school.
why_wrong: to do ไม่ขนานกับ helping
do ไม่ขนาน
done ไม่ขนาน

items.stem: (9) Next month, we will go back to visit them and ___ them our photos.
items.explanation_th: will go back … and show (V1 หลัง will)
why_wrong: showing ไม่ขนาน
to show ไม่ขนาน
shown ไม่ขนาน

items.stem: (10) I am looking forward to seeing Uncle Chai and ___ more of his stories.
items.explanation_th: looking forward to seeing … and hearing
why_wrong: hear ไม่ขนาน
to hear ไม่ขนาน
heard ไม่ขนาน
